arguments.title: Maple Crossing — Investment and Sales Offering Memorandum (Revised)
arguments.subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: Executive summary (what changed)
paragraphs: Revision effective 2026-09-01 per revision notice and revised certified rent roll.

Changes implemented: (i) Suite 002 is active and its scheduled monthly rent increased by $225 to $7,025; (ii) capitalization rate increased by 25 bps to 7.00%; (iii) initial sizing rate increased by 75 bps to 7.25%. All other underwriting rules and assumptions unchanged.

Headline results versus prior: Underwritten EGI $783,830 (was $781,265); NOI before reserves $531,078 (was $528,590); value at 7.00% cap $7.587MM (was $7.831MM at 6.75%); maximum loan $4.931MM (was $5.090MM); estimated net cash out ~$537k (was ~$694k).

sections.heading: Property and suite mix
paragraphs: Unit groups remain per manager mapping: A=Small, B=Standard, C=Large. Total suites 10; total area 32,150 SF. Physical occupancy still 9 of 10 (Suite 010 vacant). Suite 002 remains active; rent updated.

sections.heading: Revised certified rent roll snapshot (as of 2026-09-01)
paragraphs: All suites and expirations unchanged from prior roll; scheduled monthly rent for Suite 002 increased to $7,025; Suite 001 amendment remains in place for in-place rent only; underwriting GPR uses scheduled (pre-amendment) rents per instruction revision now incorporating the changed Suite 002 schedule.

sections.heading: Underwriting summary (revised)
paragraphs: Underwritten GPR: $821,400 (reflects higher scheduled rent for Suite 002). Economic loss 5%: $41,070. Other income unchanged: $3,500/year. Underwritten EGI: $783,830.
Expenses remain taxes $85,964; insurance $28,655; other recurring opex $114,618; management fee 3% of EGI. NOI before reserves: $531,078. Reserves $3,000. NCF after reserves: $528,078.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and valuation (revised)
paragraphs: Capitalization rate increased to 7.00%, yielding value of $7.59MM on revised NOI. Sizing note rate increased to 7.25%; constraints unchanged: 65% LTV, 1.25x DSCR, 9% debt yield, 30-year amortization.
Constraint results: LTV $4.931MM (binding), DSCR $5.161MM, Debt Yield $5.868MM. Sized loan $4.931MM. After 1% origination, $45k closing, and $4.30MM payoff, estimated net cash out ~$537k.

sections.heading: Risks and notes (unchanged unless stated)
paragraphs: Pending included in manager headline — Present; physical occupancy per certified roll controls. Near-term rollover — Absent. Missing insurance — Absent. Capital in opex — Absent. Unsigned rent change referenced — Present. Temporary free rent — Absent. Sizing floor binding — Absent (note 6.50% > 6.00% floor; sizing now 7.25% by instruction). Refinance shortfall — Absent (positive net cash out).

sections.heading: Source notes (revised)
paragraphs: Revised certified rent roll as of 2026-09-01 and revision notice drive the updates; all other sources as in the prior OM.
